notes: DIMVA-runner (Phase P05, priority P1, venue dimva): implemented the uniform multi-arm campaign runner at evaluation/venue2027/dimva/runner.py (RUNNER_VERSION 1.0.0, exact contract run_campaign(config) -> RunBundle). Reuses the audited shared harness evaluation.venue2027._shared.harness. Executes all registered detector arms (in-process B0, B1, B2, B3, candidate; pinned external arms B2_ISOLATION_FOREST, B3_GBT) under strictly equal configuration (equal timeouts, equal seeds, equal budgets). First-class recording of all mutually exclusive outcomes (ADMIT, REJECT, INDETERMINATE, TIMEOUT, EXECUTION_ERROR, NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL, INVALID_RESULT); verdicts, scores, seeds, source commit, and pair digests recorded per cell. NO LABEL LEAKAGE: case views sanitized so detector arms receive only leak-safe minimal events ((actor_id, tool, scope, allowed, ts)) with no campaign labels, scenario families, or reason codes (RQ1 masking preserved); oracle truth derived independently by evaluation.venue2027.dimva.independent_oracle. Tests (evaluation/venue2027/dimva/test_runner.py, 15 passed): positive controls (every arm x session pair recorded, 25 default pairs accounted, deterministic pair digests, RQ1 low-and-slow candidate detection vs B0/B1 miss preserved, idempotent resumable journaling); adversarial controls (crashing arm recorded as EXECUTION_ERROR not dropped, seed drift refused, budget disparity refused, label leakage prevented, malformed config refused). Real sample run bundle persisted to research/venue2027/proof/artifacts/dimva_run_bundle.jsonl (25 pairs recorded, complete: true, denominator_total: 25).
